💻 Controls:

T - Chat.
CTRL - Crouch.

Do You have what it takes to survive all 6 waves?

Zombie Survival Garry's Mod is a game where a group of Survivors are present in an apocalyptic world with a threat of an incoming zombie horde hungry for their brains. Humans must prepare and work together and fight-off the zombies in order to prevail.

Work together with other survivors, create barricades using Carpenter's Hammer, cooperate, defeat Mini-Bosses, heal eachother using Medkits, and purchase arsenal of powerful weapons to gain an upperhand in-game.
